title: DIGIWAVE: PPG-style wavetable machine
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: DIGIWAVE, a wavetable SRC machine in the PPG manner: two wavetable oscillators and a sub per track, 26 tables of 16 waves in 8 bits (22 made fresh: PWM, harmonic and odd builds, resonant saw and square, vowels, sync, FM, folds, phase distortion, grit and more; 4 from the Jomox Alphabase). WAVE picks the place in the table and a decay envelope sweeps it (ENV, DEC); STEP goes from smooth sweeps to hard PPG steps; BITS crushes. Page 2: osc 2's table, wave offset, tune, detune, mix, the sub, and VIEW, a 3D picture of the table. TABL and WAVE draw the table and the wave they play. The Digitakt's filter, amp, LFO and FX follow as on a sample. Machine 33. Needs machine-pages 1.5 or newer.
